title: Extend Entities Like Vector Owner Pattern
description: Extend all Entity/Diff/Operation types in compose/graphql/target.schema.graphql like Vector: section comments (# WeakEntity / StrongEntity / Modification), typed owner union field, nullable ownerX refs per union member, ownerEntity and ownedEntities with union comments, then # Fields.
summary: Aligned Entity surface with Vector-style blocks: section markers (# WeakEntity / StrongEntity / Modification / Diff), typed owner union (owner: XOwner), nullable owner<Type> narrowing fields per union variant where feasible, ownerEntity + ownedEntities (OwnedEntityConnection) with union comments, then # Fields for payload fields. Updated Diff interface with owner: DiffOwner plus ownerDiffs/ownerChange/ownerOperation and applied to PlaneDiff/PositionDiff/LocationDiff/AttributeDiff/PlaceDiff. Extended Operation interface with owner: OperationOwner + ownerChange and applied Kit/VCS/Design/File/Piece/Connector/strong entities and Operation implementations. Renamed union OwnsEntityConnection → OwnedEntityConnection (matches Entity). AttributesDiff now implements Entity; AttributesDiff added to OwnerEntity union. Fixed accidental truncation of Position type body while adding PositionOwned comment.
